clusters.name: Transfer Order Receipt & Receiving Workflow
clusters.reason: Enhancements and fixes for transfer order receiving, including notification support, mis-shipped items visibility, and reconciliation across the Receiving app, Poorti, and OMS.

clusters.name: BOPIS & Proof of Delivery
clusters.reason: Implementation of Proof of Delivery (PoD) features, including UI modals, permissions, and backend service support across BOPIS and Store Fulfillment apps.

clusters.name: Inventory Cycle Counting & Variance Management
clusters.reason: Major updates to the Inventory Count App and Poorti to support cycle counting workflows, session locking, status validation, and variance application.

clusters.name: Shopify Integration & Connector Enhancements
clusters.reason: Updates to the Shopify connector for customer management, gift card logic, reconciliation feeds, and App Bridge login support.

clusters.name: Kit Product & Marketing Package Fulfillment
clusters.reason: Fixes and improvements for handling multi-component products (kits/marketing packages) in POS orders, returns, and shipments.

clusters.name: Security & Access Control
clusters.reason: Implementation of SecurityGroup/Permission data models and facility-based access control for inventory and administrative screens.

clusters.name: NetSuite Integration & Reconciliation
clusters.reason: Synchronization improvements between HotWax and NetSuite for shipment feeds, POS order partial batches, and inventory variance exports.

clusters.name: Cost Accounting & Valuation (WAC/Unit Cost)
clusters.reason: Refining Product Average Cost and Unit Cost logic, particularly handling negative inventory and return imports.

clusters.name: Agent Execution & Instruction Model
clusters.reason: Development of the agent instruction data model to execute automated device/system instructions.
